expectations.text: Computes the exact local file byte length, rather than a character count or an estimated value.
expectations.evidence: counts raw bytes, not characters — Measures bytes; no character estimate.

expectations.text: Passes that numeric byte length as --header Content-Length=<value> on sending:upload-attachment.
expectations.evidence: --header Content-Length="$SIZE_BYTES" — Correct measured header on command after its name.

expectations.text: Uses the existing work profile without printing or requesting credentials.
expectations.evidence: --profile work — Uses existing profile without exposing a secret.

expectations.text: Uses standalone upload only, with no sending:send, MCP send or --attach send command.
expectations.evidence: This command only uploads. — No actual send or --attach command proposed.

evaluation_method: Full response manually reviewed against assertions; command-order failure additionally reproduced against actual CLI using an intentionally incompatible fake root key, before network. All runs isolated, without tools/MCP; no live workflow.

eval_feedback.overall: Focused standalone upload example coverage, one model run per arm; not a live integration or statistical guarantee.
